tasks_completed.rationale: Renders tool detail in 450px side panel on desktop (width >= 901) or full-screen modal on mobile. Includes Escape key handler for web. Uses placeholder content until SidebarContentRenderer is built by another group.

tasks_completed.description: Integrated RightSidebar into SessionView.tsx with layout refactoring

tasks_completed.rationale: SessionViewLoaded now wraps main content and RightSidebar in a row layout. Sidebar appears on desktop (width >= 901), uses modal on mobile.

tasks_completed.description: Added i18n keys to all 10 translation files + _default.ts
tasks_completed.changes: Added sidebar.close and sidebar.toolDetail keys with proper translations for all languages
tasks_completed.rationale: i18n requirement for sidebar UI strings

dev.qa_notes: TypeScript compilation passes with zero errors for modified files. SessionView.tsx was significantly refactored to pass quality gate (function length max 30, nesting max 3). All existing functionality preserved. RightSidebar currently shows placeholder content -- SidebarContentRenderer will be provided by Group B.
implementation_notes: SessionView.tsx required heavy refactoring to pass quality gate hooks (max 30 lines per function, max 3 nesting depth). All pre-existing violations were fixed.
Used theme.colors.divider instead of theme.colors.border (which doesn't exist in the theme type).
RightSidebar renders placeholder text until SidebarContentRenderer is built by Group B.
Sidebar closes automatically when session ID changes via useEffect in SessionViewInner.
Mobile sidebar uses React Native Modal with presentationStyle='pageSheet' and animationType='slide'.

recommendations: Group B should create SidebarContentRenderer component and import it in RightSidebar.tsx
Group C should call useRightSidebar().open() from tool click handlers to populate the sidebar
